detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #5 Windows Mode A Windows-looking browser leaves plenty of other signals to explain. PH4NTXM's Windows mode coordinates a Windows-aligned persona across selected hardware views, browser settings, DHCP, and TCP/IP behavior. It uses the MSFT 5.0 DHCP vendor class, mode-specific network settings, and packet transformations that keep the supported traffic aligned with that profile. The underlying operating system remains Linux. This is a coordinated persona across managed surfaces, with explicit limits on what is transformed. Unbound, firewall supervision, and the physical-output guard remain part of the protection chain. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
